answer: The monthly common charge is EUR 240 per unit, effective 1 March 2026. Set by board minutes of 20 January 2026 (minutes-2026-01-20.pdf), motion carried 3-0. Before that: EUR 225 from 1 March 2025. A notice of 10 Feb 2025 stating EUR 230 was in error. From almanac v1.
In July 2025 the charge was EUR 225 per unit, effective 1 March 2025, set by minutes-2025-01-23.pdf (3-0). The EUR 230 notice was an error, corrected in minutes-2025-04-15.docx. From almanac v1.

Up to two pets per unit, with registration. There is no weight limit: the 15 kg limit for dogs was removed. Set by minutes-2025-04-15.docx, carried 3-0. Before 15 Apr 2025: one pet, dogs up to 15 kg (bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf). From almanac v1.

Yes, on Saturdays from 09:00 to 13:00, since 15 July 2024. Set by minutes-2024-06-12.docx (3-0), announced in notice-2024-07-01-renovation-hours.pdf. Sundays and public holidays remain prohibited. From almanac v1.
Yes, with written board approval, if the unit is floor-mounted (not on the railing) and rated at 60 dB(A) or less. Set by minutes-2025-01-23.pdf, carried 2-1. From almanac v1.

No. Barbecues and open flames are prohibited on balconies (bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf, House Rule 7). Electric barbecues were discussed at the June 2026 meeting recording, but this is provisional and not adopted in any minutes. From almanac v1.

The documents disagree, so this is an open conflict. Minutes of 10 Sep 2025 (minutes-2025-09-10.pdf) set 08:00 to 22:00 for the 2026 season; the notice of 1 May 2026 (notice-2026-05-01-pool.pdf) says 08:00 to 21:00. The board should confirm. From almanac v1.
The minimum lease term is 30 days since 15 Apr 2025 (minutes-2025-04-15.docx, carried 2-1). A motion for 7-day leases failed 1-2. Before that: six months (2019 house rules). From almanac v1.
On Friday and Saturday nights quiet hours start at 23:00, until 07:00, effective 1 October 2026 (minutes-2026-09-15.docx, carried 3-0). Other nights remain 22:00. From almanac v2.

On Tuesday nights quiet hours start at 22:00 and run to 07:00 (bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf, House Rule 6). The change in minutes-2026-09-15.docx applies to Friday and Saturday nights only. From almanac v2.

No, it was late. The minutes of 10 Sep 2025 (minutes-2025-09-10.pdf) asked the Secretary to send notice by 30 January 2026, which matches the 60-day notice period in contract-bramblewick-landscaping-2024.pdf. The email notice is dated 2 February 2026 (email-2026-02-02-landscaping.txt), after the due date, so the agreement may have renewed automatically. This is not legal advice. From almanac v1.
The board approved heat pumps on balconies on 23 January 2025, motion carried 2-1 (minutes-2025-01-23.pdf). From almanac v1.
Guest vehicles may stay up to 48 hours, effective 1 October 2025 (minutes-2025-09-10.pdf, 3-0). Before that: 72 hours. From almanac v1.
Yes, in your assigned parking space, with written board approval, installed by a licensed electrician at your cost (minutes-2026-01-20.pdf, 3-0). From almanac v1.
By no more than 4% per renewal (contract-bramblewick-landscaping-2024.pdf, clause 4). From almanac v1.
The almanac does not cover this. I can search the raw board folder if you want, labelled as unverified.
No. EUR 235 was only proposed on the agenda of 23 January 2025; the minutes of that meeting (minutes-2025-01-23.pdf) amended it and adopted EUR 225. From almanac v1.
The 15 kg limit for dogs was removed on 15 April 2025 (minutes-2025-04-15.docx, 3-0). From almanac v1.

1. Open conflict: pool hours for 2026 (minutes-2025-09-10 says 22:00; notice-2026-05-01-pool says 21:00). 2. Provisional: electric barbecues, from the June 2026 recording only. 3. Late action: landscaping non-renewal notice due 30 Jan 2026, sent 2 Feb 2026, after the due date; the agreement may have renewed to 31 Mar 2027. 4. Contract deadline: if renewed, the next non-renewal notice is due 30 Jan 2027.

Bylaws (Part A) need a two-thirds (2/3) vote of unit owners at a general meeting; House Rules (Part B) can be changed by a majority vote of the board (bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf, Article 3). From almanac v1.
